name: Polymarket BTC reported-side trade flow
description: Market-generation-scoped signed Polymarket outcome flow over causal monotonic-receipt windows of (close minus duration, close]. Up BUY and Down SELL contribute positively toward Up; Up SELL and Down BUY contribute negatively. reported_side is provider vocabulary whose maker/taker meaning is not verified, so flow_semantics is explicitly provider_reported_side rather than aggressor flow. Ready output requires sixty seconds of uninterrupted observation while the venue is alive; a quiet window with zero in-window trades then publishes truthful zeros rather than degrading, where alive means any book, quote, trade, or contract input admitted within staleness_bound_ms (10000 ms), and no admitted venue input inside that bound degrades trade_stale_or_missing. A market_transition clears every flow window. Decimal values are rounded to at most eight places using round-half-to-even.
